constraints.description: Every bounded Flutter plan and OpenSpec criterion must map to reproducible current evidence.

validation.validation_method: acceptance matrix, task receipts, current verifier output, and evidence path checks

constraints.description: Flutter 3.44.8 host gates, 70 package tests, 25 showcase tests, and one iOS plus one Android smoke lane must remain directly evidenced.

validation.validation_method: task-5 receipt hash and platform disposition checks

constraints.description: All three stable goldens must retain their certified hashes, while simulator semantics and goldens must not be inflated into native assistive-technology certification.

validation.validation_method: SHA-256 recomputation and explicit evidence-boundary review

constraints.description: The example must retain one application-owned normalized graph, generated controller ownership, atomic untrusted JSONL preflight, catalog/action allowlists, tenant/task policy, and approval gates.

validation.validation_method: stable test receipt and trust-boundary evidence review

constraints.description: Coverage, Flutter provenance, Dart public declarations, release guidance, skills, OpenSpec, and the A2UI patch Changeset must agree with the implemented showcase boundary.

validation.validation_method: coverage/provenance verifiers, 44 focused tests, file checks, and strict OpenSpec

constraints.description: In-memory offline behavior, simulator/emulator evidence, non-native accessibility evidence, experimental GenUI, and hosted-service exclusions must remain explicit.

validation.validation_method: verification, release-impact, coverage, README, and skill cross-review

constraints.description: The frozen React 3.0.0-rc.1 source on remote main must remain unchanged; Flutter continuation work may only feed a later coordinated prerelease.

validation.validation_method: git remote main reference and Changesets/release-impact checks

constraints.description: QA may certify the bounded Flutter showcase but must not claim npm, pub.dev, app-store, stable 3.0, physical-device, or durable-persistence completion.

validation.validation_method: coverage status, release-impact, evidence language, and registry-boundary assertions

global_rules: Use current repository, retained device receipts, and signed KBD evidence as authoritative.
Do not convert an external, manual, experimental, or not-applicable gate into a passing repository claim.
Do not mutate npm, pub.dev, an app store, or any public release state during QA.
Lead reflection with gaps and deltas rather than success claims.
termination_conditions: Both manifest variants exist and are non-empty.
Manifest, constraints, and refinement state validate.
No material correction remains before fresh adversarial review.
